title: Drive As You Like: Multi-Head Diffusion with Reinforcement Learning for Personalized Driving
abstract: arXiv:2508.16947v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Personalized autonomous driving requires understanding the driving needs implicit in user requests. This is challenging when driving demonstrations lack style annotations and behavioral adaptation risks degrading planning quality. We propose M-Diffusion Planner with a dual-decoupling design: separating intent understanding from trajectory planning, and general planning capability learning from strategy alignment. A large language model infers driving needs and selects a strategy, which is executed by the corresponding head of a shared diffusion planner. Following imitation pretraining, strategy-specific rewards specialize individual heads without style annotations. We innovatively adapt Group Relative Policy Optimization using surrogate policy-ratio estimation and constrained head-specific updates to mitigate degradation of pretrained planning capabilities. translated_title: 随心驾驶：基于强化学习的多头扩散模型个性化驾驶
translated_abstract: 个性化自动驾驶需要理解用户请求中隐含的驾驶需求。当驾驶演示数据缺乏风格标注、且行为适应可能导致规划质量退化时，这一任务极具挑战性。我们提出了具有双重解耦设计的 M-Diffusion Planner：一方面将意图理解与轨迹规划分离，另一方面将通用规划能力学习与策略对齐分离。大语言模型负责推断驾驶需求并选择相应策略，该策略由共享扩散规划器中对应的头（head）执行。在模仿学习预训练之后，通过特定策略的奖励对各头进行专门化训练，而无需风格标注。我们创新性地改进了组相对策略优化（GRPO），采用代理策略比率估计和受约束的特定头更新机制，以缓解预训练规划能力的退化。在 nuPlan 数据集上的开环与闭环评估展示了明显的差异化风格表现（原文截断）。
tldr: 提出 M-Diffusion Planner，通过双重解耦设计将大语言模型意图理解与多头扩散规划器结合，并创新性改进 GRPO 强化学习，在无需风格标注的情况下实现个性化驾驶风格且不损害预训练规划质量。
en_tdlr: Proposes M-Diffusion Planner, which combines LLM-based intent understanding with a multi-head diffusion planner and an innovatively adapted GRPO reinforcement learning method, enabling personalized driving styles without style annotations while preserving pretrained planning quality.
